result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A's mark, a drill derrick over a water drop inside a badge, is tied directly to well drilling, and its forest green, gold and rust palette suits a rural trade business. B is a clean, flat, single-color treatment that would work well at small sizes, but its mark is little more than a stock water drop with a wave through it. A uses somewhat more colors, and its smallest version (about 62px) is above the requested 32–48px range, where the drop becomes hard to make out. Even so, A has the stronger and more specific idea. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B's mark is a drilling derrick striking water inside a badge, which is clearly about well drilling. A's water drop with a wave is close to the stock drop the rubric warns against, though A is cleaner and shows the logo in flat single colors. B uses more colors and its smallest version is about 60px with no single-color version, but its stronger concept and well-set type make it the better logo overall.
